findings.finding: Every active project was rendered into every turn's context, whoever started it.
findings.evidence: MemoryBridge.formatProjects now authorizes each project; tests H

findings.finding: Project contents reached an agent with no ownership check (contextFor had no access parameter).
findings.evidence: AgentRunner passes the run scope; tests I

findings.finding: No project recorded who created it or in which conversation, so the question could not even be asked.
A durable project begun in another chat appeared as current work with no indication of where it came from.
findings.evidence: projectLabel + projectContextNote; tests H; provider turn A shows the label

findings.finding: Existing projects have no origin recorded; rewriting them would be destructive.
findings.policy: treated as user-persistent and unowned: visible, unlabelled, never claimed by another user. Nothing deleted or rewritten.

residual_risks: This build is single-user, so records written from the Projects panel carry ownerId null and the UI has no way to set one. Ownership is enforced whenever it is recorded (tests create two owners), but a real second account would need the identity threaded into project creation.
Project items are independent user content; they are not linked to memory ids, so forgetting a memory does not edit a project note that quoted it.
